criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Frames 1, 2, 3 and 6 read as places, 3 the best image. The detail runs backwards: 7 and 8 a thin flat strip under a dead sky band with no post shadows, 5 a flat khaki door with a hard black seam, 9 no sun or glow and the plant a black wall with the foreground lit warm, barbed wire where the dossier names chain link, 4's empty bottom third, the mannequin on 1 and 2, no visible grime on 6.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One world, one hero, the 7 to 8 swipe is the turn. Frame 5 an undeclared value cut mid deck, 9's fence carryover reads only as the plant's wall.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces, drawn ratios measure correctly. Frame 4's bar spans Region 1 in the picture, frame 8's label drops c30's exception, the caption's 99.8 million omits c21's scope.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Who, where, what and when named, a concrete stake, the CEO beside the witness. The reader's action only implied.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns it, 2 pays, 7 to 8 a genuine turn. 3 and 4 both answer how big, the close is status.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean, sharp hooks. 7 and 8 run long in near legal paraphrase, specificity geographic more than vernacular.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Fence ruler and transformer pocket fresh, one familiar move in the enclosures on caliche.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild frames 7 and 8 as one low three quarter camera down the fence with the red bridge panels large in the foreground and post shadows raking the caliche.
